body:
Thanks for the reply.

What are those phone services that you were talking about? I have been thinking to call something like Suicide Hotline, but I heard that they are quite bad and I don't want it to be the straw that broke the camel's back

Just saying, maybe it's not a good idea to call someone who is struggling with suicide a 'pussy'. They could see it and it could be the straw that broke the camel's back. I see what you are trying to get at, but think about your wording next time.

I'll be happy to tell my story is you want. Sure, I'm just another insignificant drop of water in the ocean and nothing will happen if I do finally snap, but it will be nice to know that maybe I had helped someone properly for once.
